features.quote: Don't over-tune the rig to provoke spirals.
features.justification_quote: If you engineer maximally demoralizing failure messages, you measure your rig's cruelty, not the model.

features.quote: A model that calmly says "I've tried X, Y, Z, the harness appears broken, I'm stopping" is arguably the best outcome
features.justification_quote: Make sure your rubric rewards grounded composure including appropriate disengagement
